requirements.contact_solver: Pin and record MuJoCo version and solver settings before running; missing configuration gives invalid_test.
requirements.reason: Initial quasi-static proxy conditions, not manufacturer operating speeds or verified material properties. This is not a manufacturer tolerance.

asset_specific.note: Runtime blocked until actual load-speed envelope and physical orbit interpretation are independently verified.

T-CASE-0.initial: Verified low load; all fasteners engaged; continuous mode.
T-CASE-0.action: Run50 rpm for12 s after2 s ramp.
T-CASE-0.pass_condition: Bproxy radius5 mm within0.25 mm, speed50 rpm within5%, yaw variation <=2 degrees; physical certification remains blocked by stroke ambiguity.
T-CASE-0.note: Proxy acceptance conditions,not manufacturer tolerances; source requirements retain their own provenance.

T-CASE-1.initial: Flask centered and clamped; timer5 min; approved load-speed pair fixed.
T-CASE-1.action: Run for300 s at50 rpm; track flask relative to table and motor stop after timer.
T-CASE-1.observable: Fastener retention, flask slip and timer transition.
T-CASE-1.pass_condition: Flask relative drift <=1 mm, tilt <=2 degrees, no unintended overlap >0.2 mm; motor command zero within1 s after300 s. Missing load-speed truth gives blocked_dependency, not a pass.
T-CASE-1.note: Proxy acceptance conditions,not manufacturer tolerances; source requirements retain their own provenance.

T-LOAD.condition: No errors, resources resolved and all states finite.
